filter_model_parameters: filter a model parameters dict to only include standard logging-safe keys
get_chat_completion_kwargs: get the set of litellm-supported chat completion kwargs from OpenAI type annotations
get_embedding_kwargs: get the set of litellm-supported embedding kwargs from OpenAI type annotations
get_rerank_kwargs: get the set of litellm-supported rerank kwargs from RerankRequest model fields
get_exclude_params: get the set of parameter names to exclude from logging (messages, prompt, input)
